fields.description: BRD C.1.4 leaves the dealer-classification measurement period/rolling window an open point (bands themselves are confirmed) — this is the configurable placeholder recompute_dealer_classifications() reads until Pacific confirms the real window.
fields.label: Dealer Classification Window (Days)

fields.description: BRD C.11 trigger #4 (BRD C.7.3: "any transaction-level price or discount change — even a one-rupee change — is an override requiring approval") is Pacific's own rule: default 0 means ANY discount at all is audit-locked, no threshold. This app is white-labeled — a different client may want a looser rule (e.g. discounts up to 5% auto-apply, only above that needs Management approval). approvals.api.gate_discount_over_price_list reads this per-site, so that's a config change, not a code change, per deployment.
fields.label: Discount Approval Threshold %

fields.description: MOM 07-Oct-2026 §3.7 / action item #6 -- "a 3-month inactivity threshold will be applied to dealer accounts." A dealer with no Sales Order, Sales Invoice, Inquiry or inbound WhatsApp message in this many days is flagged Inactive by sales.dealer_activity.flag_inactive_dealers (daily).
fields.label: Dealer Inactivity Threshold (Days)

fields.description: MOM §3.7 -- "inactive dealers will be flagged and Prashant Sir will be notified." The one user notified when dealers go inactive, plus the monthly active-dealer-number digest. Left blank, every enabled DMS Management user is notified instead -- a named person is per-client config, never hardcoded.
fields.label: Notify on Dealer Inactivity

fields.description: ISS-2026-00635 -- "Max buffer: 21 days (7+7+7)." An open Sales Order (not yet Dispatched/Delivered/Cancelled) older than this many days is flagged for review by sales.reservation.review_reservations (daily). Never auto-cancelled.
fields.label: Reservation Window (Days)

fields.description: ISS-2026-00635 -- "Auto-send reminder notification at day 14+6 (day 20)." Once an open Sales Order is this many days old, its dealer's salesperson (or Management, if none) gets one reminder. Must be less than the Reservation Window.
fields.label: Reservation Reminder Day
Inquiry Drop Reasons
fields.description: One reason per line, offered when staff close or reject an inquiry without a customer PO (BRD C.2.3). "Other" always asks for details. Leave empty to use the standard list.
